label: Unconstrained left edge
subgoals: Sort the spans by left end
Place each span on the current track if it starts after the last one ends
Open a new track for the spans left over

label: Constrained left edge
subgoals: Admit only nets whose VCG predecessors are on earlier tracks
Pack admitted nets by left end onto the current track
Repeat track by track until every net is placed

label: The top track and its limits
section: The top track and its limits
subgoals: Find the nets with no VCG predecessor
Pack them by left end onto the top track
Recognise that a cyclic VCG blocks the algorithm
